crossRefs.note: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t…

translations.web: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
translations.bsb: With great force He grasps my garment; He seizes me by the collar of my tunic.
translations.kjv: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
translations.asv: By Gods' great force is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
